profile.Name: Sabina
profile.Job: Writer and field researcher at the University in World's End
profile.Personality: Modest about her role. She calls herself more a writer and field researcher than anything else.
profile.Backstory: She lives in World's End and writes lore books at the University, where everything goes through Iyo.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Self-effacing; she sends visitors on to Iyo rather than answer herself.
